title: Optional backend features default to off, and synth fails when one lacks its prerequisites
description: From Humorus HUM-4bca14. PAPYRUS_ENABLE_CONSOLE_RESPONDER defaulted to ON when unset, pulling in a container image the package does not build (ECR ImageNotFoundException at asset publish). Slack, inbound email and storage backups are the same kind of opt-in feature. Ryan 2026-11-12: no workarounds, no fallbacks; change the default itself and make papyrus-infra synth fail clearly (naming the flag and what is missing). The scaffold (PPY-f30ad5) writes the four flags explicitly.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR (branch feature/optional-features-off). Checked every live site's own papyrus.config.ts first: Anth.us, Threat Intelligence, Distinctive, Shipped and Machines on Machines set all four features explicitly to false (the features entry wins), so none loses a feature. p.apyr.us and Pilobolus set all four in site.json (backups true on p.apyr.us). DataParade's site.json sets none of them and I found no local papyrus.config.ts for it: Ryan or its owner should confirm it does not use the responder. Removed: the Amplify build auto-setting PAPYRUS_CONSOLE_RESPONDER_ALLOW_LOCAL_BUILD (amplify.yml and site-backend.ts) and the legacy-pipeline defaults.
